title: Launch Checklist
summary: Put it all together: objects, parentheses and round() to compute z-scores.
hints: Store each given number in its own object first, e.g. `class_mean <- 60`.
A z-score is (score − mean) / SD. The subtraction must happen first, so wrap it in parentheses: `(my_score - class_mean) / class_sd`.
To print a value rounded to two decimals, put `round(z, digits = 2)` on its own line.
